main_text.l: חמל ܚܡܠ Syr. Collegit, congregavit, coegit,
Matth.6.26. & Lucæ 12.17.
חמם Ch. Incalescere, Calidum esse vel fieri: Syr.
Verrere, Everrere, Scopis mundare, purga-
re, Idè quod Ch. חמם, Part. ܚܡܝܢܐ Et verrit, Luc.15.
8. Pehil ܚܡܐ Scopis mundatum, Matth.12.44.
חומא, חומתא Ch. ܚܡܬܐ Syr. Calor, Æstus. Af-
fine est Græc. κᾶυμα.
חמים Ch. Calidus. 1.Sam. 21.7. Vide præterea in חמת & יחם.
חמם Chald. Rapere, abripere, auferre. Ex Ithpahel
אתחמסי Abrepta est.Gen.7.21.in Jon. Heb. וינוע
Et expiravit. Pravum videtur pro אתחמיים.
חומסין Ch.Raptores. Genef.6.11.in Targ.Hierof.ex for-
ma Hebraea,pro חַמְסִין,vel חמוסין.
ܚܡܫ Syr. Consistere, persistere, durare, perdu-
rare, perseverare, ferre, sustinere, tenere, retinere.
חמע Ch.& Syr. Fermentari. Ab Hebraeo חמץ, per
cōmutationem litterarum ץ & ע. Aphel אחמע
Fermentare.
חמיע Ch. Fermentatum, Exod.12.15.
מחמע, מחמעא Ch.Idem. Ibid.v.20.in Onk.& Jon.
חמע Ch.Acetum,Num.6.3.in Targ.Hierof. Heb.חמץ.
חמין Pahel Ch. Cōtristare, tristitiam afferre. Aphel
אחמין Cōturbare, pudefacere, pudore suffun-
dere, Ignominiâ afficere, Prov.25.8. & 28.7.
חמוצא Ch. Tristitia,Mœror,Prov.14.13. & 17.21.
חומצ Ch.Acetum, Prov.10.26. Hebr. חומץ.
ܚܡܫܝܐ

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are transcribed as best read; the Syriac and some vocalised Hebrew words in the scan are blurred and may be imperfect. The signature-like mark at the foot right is a Syriac-style flourish, not a catchword, and is not transcribed as text.
